name: Erevos Descent
detailed_description:
Try to endure pain like never before in this dark action-puzzle game. Find your way through a mysterious world filled with old ruins, restless spirits, and creatures that never stop watching you. Use your enchanted torch to guide you through the shadows, and fend off deadly, inconceivable horrors. Explore the fog-covered wasteland… and don’t let the flame die, or else…

A world where nothing makes sense. Welcome!

You wake up, with nothing on you except sore memories of the past. Half-finished thoughts lingering in your head, trying desperately to make sense of themselves. You awaken in a world that defies logic—a wasteland of silence and shadow. Nothing visible except a long-winded river, and a never-ending feel of dread. Endless fields stretching into a choking mist. Strange forces are around you, whispers engulf you, faint shadows flicker about; it is safe to say, you are not alone.

The Monsters

You are not alone in this place. Something watches. Something listens.

As you move, you encounter dozens of unfathomable beings. In the large abyss that engulfs you a presence with too many eyes sees everything. You can run. You can hide. But you are always being watched. It moves without warning, patient, tireless. You’ll feel it before you hear it—and by then, it may be too late.

Deep underground, something ancient and heavy walks in endless circles. It might not see you as well, but it hears you. Your breath. Your footsteps. Your fear. Even the stillness isn’t safe.

And then there are the voices. In the silent wastelands, you hear sounds, echoes, and whispers; they are everywhere, and anywhere.

Some beg. Some laugh. Some lie.

They drift through the ruins, slipping into your thoughts like fog. They know things you don’t. They remember you.

Whether they’ll help you... or haunt you... is not yours to decide.

These are not monsters. They are warnings.

Keep your torch lit.

The Torch

This flame you have acquired is no ordinary fire—it's your only lifeline in a world that defies all logic and sense.

Controlled only by the torch it is connected to, its power will help you progress. Fueled by the strange coins scattered across the land, this mystical torch carries powers beyond understanding.

Its searing light can burn through monsters and spirits alike, warding off any creature that lurk in the shadows. And with its bright glow reveals hidden paths, forgotten markings, and doors in places you never thought a door could be.

With enough fuel, the torch can pierce through the dark fog and awaken forgotten mechanisms, but beware—every spark consumes a coin, and the flame won’t last forever. Find the strange coins scattered across this horrid land, or suffer a fate not wished upon your worst enemy.

Keep it lit, keep it close, and maybe... just maybe... you’ll find your way out. Or something will find you first.

short_description: A dark action-puzzle adventure where you wield a magical torch to burn monsters, unlock hidden paths, and power ancient mechanisms—all while solving puzzles and surviving stealth encounters in a haunting, unknowable world. Explore a forgotten world... and keep the flame alive.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Greek, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64 Bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i3 9100 or AMD Ryzen 5 3500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or RX RADEON 580
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, Native, 30fps
